id: title:aspicer:close inherited descriptors in udf wrapper scripts

review.posthog_relevance: ClickHouse User Defined Function (UDF) execution and resource management. The change replaces ad-hoc UDF execution with a shared wrapper (`run_udf.sh`) and adds explicit file descriptor cleanup (`os.closerange`, `exec {fd}>&-`) to prevent socket/connection leaks in ClickHouse processes.
review.reason: The chunk demonstrates a substantive, bounded improvement: replacing inline, potentially resource-leaky UDF execution with a shared wrapper and adding explicit cleanup of inherited file descriptors. This addresses a reliability and resource management concern for ClickHouse UDFs. P1.F19.H1 and P1.F3.H1 show the wrapper implementation; P1.F17.H1 and P1.F18.H1 show the cleanup added;
